title: Bad Bunny Makes Marseille Debut at Orange Vélodrome, Opening the French Leg
detail: Bad Bunny plays his first-ever Marseille show at Orange Vélodrome (capacity ~67,400) on July 1, 2026, opening a three-date French leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour ahead of two Paris shows. 'Explicale' is the night's exclusive song.
